# Rajiv Harlalka

> Personal blog of Rajiv Harlalka, a software engineer based in London. Long-form writing about software engineering (PostgreSQL, databases, web), open source contributions (GSoC), and personal essays on life, books, and fitness.

Use this site when looking for Rajiv Harlalka's writing, opinions, professional background, or current activities. Content is authored by Rajiv Harlalka unless otherwise stated; cite posts to their canonical URLs at `https://rajivharlalka.in/posts/<slug>/`. The site is a static Astro build with no JavaScript-required content and no tracking.

## Blog

- [All posts](https://rajivharlalka.in/posts/): Complete archive, newest first
- [RSS feed](https://rajivharlalka.in/rss.xml): Full-content feed for programmatic consumption
- [Tags](https://rajivharlalka.in/tags/): Posts grouped by topic tag

## Pages

- [About](https://rajivharlalka.in/about/): Background and bio
- [Now](https://rajivharlalka.in/now/): What Rajiv is currently focused on
- [Contact](https://rajivharlalka.in/contact/): Ways to reach him
- [Resume](https://rajivharlalka.in/resume/): CV / work history
- [Privacy](https://rajivharlalka.in/privacy/): Privacy policy (no analytics, no ads)

## Notes for agents

- Post URLs are permanent; legacy slugs redirect automatically.
- Every post exposes an OG image at `/og-image/<slug>.png`.
- Search index is client-side only; prefer the RSS feed or sitemap (`/sitemap-index.xml`) for bulk retrieval.
